description: Source code for the SensorsSubHal implementation in Android HAL, managing sensor list, activation, batching, flushing, and debugging functionalities.

classes.name: ISensorsSubHalBase
classes.description: Implementation of the sensors sub-HAL interface, providing methods for sensor management and debugging.

methods.name: getSensorsList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of available sensors.

methods.name: setOperationMode
methods.description: Sets the operation mode of the sensor HAL.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a sensor based on handle.

methods.name: batch
methods.description: Configures sensor sampling period and report latency.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the sensor HAL with callback.

methods.name: postEvents
methods.description: Posts sensor events with wake lock management.
